inbox.title: Inbox

inbox.coverageNote: Shows only what Instagram shares with this app, not your full history. Nothing is sent from here.

inbox.igDm.recovery.noWorker: No Worker is connected, so these DMs can't be checked now. They're kept; connect the Worker in Settings to check them.
inbox.igDm.err.unconfigured: Connect the Worker in Settings first.
inbox.igDm.err.auth: The Worker refused the token. Check it in Settings.
inbox.igDm.err.not_configured: The Worker isn't set up for Instagram DMs yet.
inbox.igDm.err.not_connected: Instagram isn't connected. Connect it in Settings. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.no_permission: This Instagram connection can't send DMs. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.token_expired: The Instagram sign-in expired. Reconnect Instagram, then try again. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.stale: The Instagram connection changed. Tap Refresh and open the conversation again. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.account_mismatch: The connected Instagram account isn't the one this DM belongs to. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.text_invalid: The DM needs text and can be at most 1,000 UTF-8 bytes (Arabic letters are about 2 bytes each, emoji about 4).
inbox.igDm.err.target_unverified: The Worker couldn't confirm this conversation and message are yours. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.target_invalid: The Worker can't answer this message from here. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.not_found: The Worker can't find this operation. That doesn't prove nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.conflict: This DM changed since it was reviewed. Prepare it again.
inbox.igDm.err.capacity: Too many DMs aren't settled yet (on this device or on the Worker). Check or cancel them, then try again.
inbox.igDm.err.rate_limited: Instagram asked us to slow down. Try again later yourself.
inbox.igDm.err.receipt_unavailable: The Worker's DM receipts aren't reachable right now.
inbox.igDm.err.mismatch: The Worker's answer didn't match this DM (another account, conversation, person, message, time, draft or text), so it wasn't trusted.
inbox.igDm.err.unavailable: Instagram DM replies aren't verified yet, so nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.notPersisted: This browser couldn't save the send record, so nothing was sent.
inbox.igDm.err.conflictLocal: Another tab changed this DM. Close and open it again.
inbox.igDm.err.cancelFailed: Couldn't confirm the cancel, so this DM stays here. Check status before anything else.
inbox.igDm.err.clearFailed: Couldn't clear the draft in this browser. It's still saved; try again.
inbox.igDm.err.superseded: Another tab updated this DM, so this answer wasn't used. Check status to see where it stands.
inbox.igDm.err.unrecorded: This browser couldn't save the latest answer about this DM. Check status to see where it stands.
inbox.igDm.err.unresolved: A DM answering this message isn't settled yet, so nothing new was prepared. Check status first.
inbox.igDm.detail.kv: It needs its storage (KV). The steps are in the Worker README.
inbox.igDm.detail.dm-claim-store: It needs its Instagram DM claim store (the INSTAGRAM_DM_COORDINATOR Durable Object). The steps are in the Worker README.
inbox.igDm.detail.permission_unverified: The exact Instagram permission for DMs isn't verified yet.
inbox.igDm.detail.identity: The Instagram sign-in belongs to another account.
inbox.igDm.detail.outside-local-window: Only your newest conversations and their newest messages can be checked from here.
inbox.igDm.detail.mixed-senders: More than one other person is in this conversation.
inbox.igDm.detail.foreign-recipient: That message came from someone else.
inbox.igDm.detail.future-time: That message's time is in the future.
inbox.igDm.detail.window-closed: That message is more than 24 hours old.
inbox.igDm.detail.inbound-changed: That message changed since the review.
inbox.igDm.detail.ambiguous-message: Instagram described that message two different ways.
inbox.igDm.detail.ambiguous-identity: Instagram's names in this conversation don't match one person each.
inbox.igControl.title: Conversation takeover
inbox.igControl.note: Take over to stop your automatic replies in this conversation, or resume them. This never sends a message, and sending a DM never changes it.
inbox.igControl.registerUnavailable: Taking over from here first needs a verified link to this conversation, and making one isn't verified yet (the exact Instagram permission hasn't been confirmed). Nothing is asked or sent. Conversations linked earlier can still be checked and changed.
inbox.igControl.registrationUncertain: We don't know whether linking this conversation reached the Worker, so there's no verified link to use here yet. Nothing was taken over and nothing was sent.
inbox.igControl.lastChecked: As last checked on this device.
inbox.igControl.countsUnknown: The in-flight and unknown-outcome counts aren't known here. Check status first.
inbox.igControl.uncertainCount: Earlier replies with an unknown outcome: {count}
inbox.igControl.rowsNotLoaded: The in-flight list isn't loaded here. Check status to see it.
inbox.igControl.blocked: A change you started isn't settled yet. Check status first; nothing is repeated from here.
inbox.igControl.change.takeover: Automatic replies on → off (you handle it)
inbox.igControl.copy.takeover: This stops future automatic replies in this conversation. Replies already authorized may still arrive: taking over can't pull them back.
inbox.igControl.copy.resume: This allows future eligible automatic replies. It doesn't replay past messages and sends nothing now.
inbox.igControl.copy.unknown: Changing the mode doesn't settle replies whose outcome is unknown.
inbox.igControl.checked: Checked just now. This check doesn't say who set the mode.
inbox.igControl.resolved: This check settles the change you started earlier, but it can't tell whether your change or something else set the mode.
inbox.igControl.done.takeover: Taken over: automatic replies are off for this conversation. Nothing was sent.
inbox.igControl.done.resume: Resumed: future eligible automatic replies are allowed again. Nothing was sent or replayed.
inbox.igControl.done.unchanged: It was already like that, so nothing changed.
inbox.igControl.conflict: The conversation changed before your request (now revision {revision}), so nothing was changed by you. Check status to see the counts, then review again.
inbox.igControl.uncertain: We don't know whether your request reached the Worker. Check status before anything else; nothing is repeated from here.
inbox.igControl.unavailable: This conversation's link isn't available on the Worker anymore (it may have been retired after a long time unused). That says nothing about the mode or any reply.
inbox.igControl.closed: The connection, account or conversation changed, so this closed. Nothing new was asked from it.
